'''Geit Chambell''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Nehanna]] disappeared, Chambell claimed that he was descended from [[Grand Vicar]] [[Sidharra]], and thus had royal blood.<ref name="Strongholds" />
